description: The Luna T7 Hybrid (HW/FW) Cryptographic Library uses a combination of hardware cryptographic accelerators and firmware to provide a suite of cryptographic operations and functionality to the Luna T7 Cryptographic Module, a tamper-resistant HSM implemented in a multi chip embedded hardware module.
